text:
You need a senior Angular developer who can step into an in-progress web application project, build polished interfaces, and collaborate smoothly for a 6+ month engagement.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building modern web applications. My background is strongest in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, and I’m comfortable working across both frontend and backend layers to keep implementation clean and maintainable. I focus on writing code that is easy to extend, responsive in the browser, and aligned with the product’s UI goals.

While my core experience is not in Angular specifically, I’m highly comfortable in TypeScript-based frontend development and working within established codebases. I understand the importance of jumping into an existing project carefully, following conventions, and quickly becoming productive without disrupting ongoing work. I also pay close attention to detail in UI implementation and care about delivering interfaces that look polished and feel consistent.

I’m especially interested in the long-term nature of this role and the need for strong communication. I’m available to commit at least 30 hours per week and can work during your required 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST window. I’m also used to clear written communication and collaborative development workflows, which helps when inheriting work from another developer and keeping progress steady.

If your priority is a dependable senior-level developer who can contribute thoughtfully, adapt quickly, and help move features forward with care, I’d be glad to discuss the project and see how I can support your team.
